title: Quentin and the Bridge
author: Ines Hartwell
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
